answer:
Ollama on Windows writes its server log to:

**`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama\server.log`**

This usually expands to `C:\Users\<your-username>\AppData\Local\Ollama\server.log`. You can paste `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Ollama` into File Explorer's address bar to open the folder.

The same folder also contains `app.log` (logs from the Ollama tray app) and `upgrade.log`. Older server logs are rotated into files such as `server-1.log`, so `server.log` is the most recent one.

You can also open the logs from the Ollama tray icon by choosing "View logs." If you run `ollama serve` yourself in a terminal, the output goes to that terminal rather than these files.
